violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw beef stored on shelf above marinades in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS recommended moving all raw meats to one side of WIC and storing raw meats following proper storage order according to cook temperature. CFM had employees start rearranging all food in WIC.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: most refrigeration units in establishment were missing thermometer.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM will replace thermometers in all units. Establishment was closed for extensive cleaning and thermometers were removed during cleaning.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed no weather stripping and door sweep on back exit door.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Install weather stripping and door sweep on back exit door to maintain closed seal to exterior of building.

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: observed small plates of portioned cabbage slaw stack on top of each other.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. CFM discarded prepared plates. CFM agreed to store plates in one layer - not stacked on top of each other with bottom of plate touching cabbage slaw.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: portioned rice in cookers between 129F-132F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM will discard rice at 1800. EHS and CFM discussed that rice cookers were overfilled with portioned containers. CFM will keep smaller portions of rice in cookers and monitor temperatures to see if able to maintain 135F or higher. If not, CFM will purchase warming cabinet.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: egg white observed at 45F in #1, yogurt drink observed at 59F in #2.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded egg white. CFM will not store TCS foods in #1. CFM will adjust #1 temperature to lower setting. CFM stated #2 was not able to hold temperature yesterday and was repaired earlier that morning. CFM discarded yogurt drink. EHS advised not to store any TCS foods in units until able to maintain proper cold holding temperature of 41F or below.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: observed raw beef over raw squid in DELFIELD 2 DR UR.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). EHS discussed storage order of raw meat in refrigeration units with CFM. EHS will provide cross contamination job aid. CFM moved raw squid to shelf above beef.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw beef on shelf above containers of marinades in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS discussed proper storage order for RTE and raw meats in equipment. EHS will provide cross-contamination job aid. CFM will move marinades to separate area of WIC.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Observed 0ppm bleach concentration at the main dish machine. EHS and CFM attempted to prime sanitizer , but feature was not working.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. CFM called for emergency service during inspection. EHS discussed using the dish machine for washing and rinsing only. Sanitizer basin on 3 compartment sink will be set up and used to sanitize all clean dishware. CFM will provide proof of repair to EHS as soon as service arrives. EHS will follow up within 3 days.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: liquid egg white at 45F in True 2 DR bar Left, liquid egg white at 45F in True 2 DR bar right.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded liquid egg white containers. CFM will replace thermometers in units and lower temperature of unit. CFM will verify units are able to maintain cold holding temperature of 41F or below before storing liquid egg white in units.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed spray bottles of windex next to clean utensils under prep table.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. CFM moved spray bottles to separate area away from food/equipment/utensils.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed spray bottles of windex, cleaner, unidentified liquid throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM will label all secondary containers with chemical name.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: bulk containers of various starches and secondary containers of spices throughout kitchen, squirt/squeeze bottles of oils and sauces throughout kitchen and refrigeration units.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will label all secondary containers of dry goods, spices, sauces, oils with food name.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wiping cloths stored on prep table surface and next to meat slicer.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS discussed storage of wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution when not in use. Sanitizer solution must be changed every 4 hours or when solution/cloth becomes visibly soiled, whichever is sooner.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. -Paper towels not provided at the handwashing sinks at the dish washer and the main preparation line.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. -Paper towels provided

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the NOODLE AREA being used TO STORE AND CLEAN BOWLS
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. -bowls removed from handwashing sink basin and moved to nearby prep sink.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. Interior of ice machine observed with discoloration and accumulation of debris.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: -Pooled egg (50F) observed portioned and stacked in top rail of prep unit -Cooked sliced beef (55F) observed in 2 Dr prep rail at noodle station -Side dishes observed at 55F in 2 Dr prep at server station.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Plastic single service bowl observed used for dispensing garlic
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. -bowl removed from garlic, discussed with PIC to replace with scoop with handle

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: -Observed wood blocks used to hold grill plates for scrubbing by dish washing area. -Observed storage racks for pots and pans lined with cardboard.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. -Cardboard discarded -Please replace wood block material with smooth and easily cleanable.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 Dr prep at server station observed holding at 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. -Food items removed from cooler unit.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature.
